### 基本概念

* [Functional programming](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Functional_programming) [函数式编程](http://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%87%BD%E6%95%B8%E7%A8%8B%E5%BC%8F%E8%AA%9E%E8%A8%80)
* [Lambda Calculus](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lambda_calculus) [λ演算](http://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%CE%9B%E6%BC%94%E7%AE%97)
* [Currying](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Currying)
* [Closure](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Closure_%28computer_science%29) [闭包](http://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E9%97%AD%E5%8C%85_%28%E8%AE%A1%E7%AE%97%E6%9C%BA%E7%A7%91%E5%AD%A6%29)
* [Higher-order functions](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Higher-order_function) [高阶函数](http://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E9%AB%98%E9%98%B6%E5%87%BD%E6%95%B0)
* [Recursion](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Recursion) [递归](http://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E9%80%92%E5%BD%92)
* [Lazy evaluation](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lazy_evaluation) [惰性求值](http://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%83%B0%E6%80%A7%E6%B1%82%E5%80%BC)
* [Fix point](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fixed_point_combinator) [不动点](http://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E4%B8%8D%E5%8A%A8%E7%82%B9%E7%BB%84%E5%90%88%E5%AD%90)
* [fold](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fold_%28higher-order_function%29)
* [Continuation](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Continuation)
* [Monad](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monad_%28functional_programming%29)
* [Compiler for Free](https://codon.com/compilers-for-free#partial-evaluation) (Partial Evaluation, Futamura projections)
